items.why: The report notes that "the 350 cm⁻¹ component overlaps E′" and tries a "two-component E′ fit". It also mentions separating "E′ from 2LA(M)-type contributions". However, it never assigns the ~351 component firmly to 2LA(M), calls it "ambiguous", and gives no stable fit.
The report gives no 2LA(M)/A1g intensity ratio and makes no spot-1 vs spot-2 comparison. It says "E′ and 2LA-type intensities are not quantified here."
Only a single A1g position (~418 cm⁻¹) is reported for one flake. There are no 417.2 vs 420.1 cm⁻¹ values for two spots and no monolayer-vs-bulk contrast.
The report gives one separation, "60.75 ± 0.24 cm⁻¹", not ~62 and ~65 cm⁻¹ for the two spots. It does not compute the separation after a stable E′/2LA(M) split.
The report says the separation "is consistent with a monolayer or few-layer flake but does not fix the layer number". It does not give the ~1 cm⁻¹ step size between 2L, 3L and bulk.
The report checks calibration against Si: "Si 520.7 cm⁻¹ reference fits to 521.6 ± 0.5 cm⁻¹". It also discusses excitation-dependent resonance at length.

wrong_claims.why: The report does build layer number on the A1g−E′ separation, with E′ at ~357 cm⁻¹. However, it explicitly fits a separate ~350 component rather than assigning the band maximum to E′ alone.
The ~350 band is never called a defect or impurity peak. The report says there is "no clear defect-activated D-like band".
